اعتصمنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمْنَا (iʕtaṣamnā) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمْنَا (uʕtuṣimnā) /uʕ.tu.sˤim.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
